summary: Implemented both review hardening gaps with scoped backend/service + API-test changes, preserving mentor endpoint contracts and validating no-write behavior when repair gate is disabled.
decisions: Used mentor-workspace-backfill operational slug for artifact materialization to keep continuity with existing operator reports.
Implemented conflict observability at service repair boundary via structured runtime logs and preserved non-overwrite behavior.
Expanded endpoint-level no-write assertions to include Command Center, Radar, and Renewal Matrix mentor GET paths.
risks: No explicit story path for this backfill adjustment was provided in implementation-artifacts; traceability was anchored to operator review artifacts.
If repair gate remains enabled during high-volume reads, conflict/info logs may increase operational noise.
